basics.name: Samuli Järvelä
basics.label: Senior Software Developer and Partner
basics.summary:
Samuli is a senior software developer with an adaptive mindset and strong expertise in modern full-stack development and system design. He leverages agentic development approaches and AI-assisted workflows to deliver efficient, high-quality solutions, and applies lean architectural principles to keep systems maintainable as they grow. He is committed to building secure, maintainable software with technologies that best serve the problem at hand.

Geared with a strong agile background and enthusiastic approach, he helps teams perform at their very best.
basics.x-tagline: Trust and better teamwork grow from taking ownership and sharing responsibility, reinforced by a genuinely hospitable attitude.

x-strengths.title: Strive for ownership & shared responsibilities
x-strengths.description: Samuli promotes strong ownership, helping people perform at their best and take responsibility for outcomes. Through alignment on shared business goals and open decision-making, he enables trust and lasting impact.

x-strengths.title: Lean startup mindset
x-strengths.description: Samuli helps teams move fast through experimentation, continuous learning, and data-driven iteration. The focus stays on meaningful outcomes and validated business impact.

x-keyRoles.title: Senior Software Developer
x-keyRoles.description: Working in senior developer roles at Telelinkki Oyj, Kanervapankki and Liftmaster Oyj, among others, Samuli naturally takes on responsibility and ownership. In addition to the software development itself, Samuli steers the direction of the product and the ways of working.

x-keyRoles.title: Agile Master
x-keyRoles.description: Beyond improving his own teams, Samuli has also supported other teams to improve development practices and processes department-wide.

x-keySkills.title: AI Experience
x-keySkills.description: Samuli has leveraged GitHub Copilot since its early adoption, making AI-assisted development a core part of modern workflows. More recently, agentic coding practices with tools like Claude Code have highlighted the transformative potential of AI-driven software production.

projects.name: Corporate growth prototypes and experiments
projects.description:
Samuli started as a developer in the client's CMS team, but was soon invited to join the Corporate Growth team working with lean and agile principles. Serving as the sole developer in the team in this fast-paced environment, he contributed to building prototypes and running experiments to validate new business ideas, leveraging lean startup methods and AI-assisted workflows and heavily utilizing AI tools.

He also introduced leaner, data-driven ways of making business decisions by focusing on meaningful KPIs and early validation through measurable outcomes.

Alongside his development work, Samuli acted as an Agile Master, supporting teams through coaching and contributing to department-level improvements in development practices and processes across the wider engineering organization.

projects.name: Customer management tool
projects.description: Developing Next.js customer management tool for point-of-sales and admin users while managing other production applications on a serverless AWS infrastructure. Designed and implemented better architecture for the application and helped the team use Next.js more efficiently.
projects.x-note: No start/end dates given in the source, only the duration.

projects.name: Application for business customers
projects.description: Responsible for creating new application for business customers. The application was developed with close collaboration with UX designer and test engineer. High quality & security standards were enforced via multi-level testing, auditing, and manual reviews. After finishing the application, joined the team working with multiple projects.

projects.name: Patient data and records management
projects.description: Responsible for creating a greenfield project together with another developer to manage patient data and records for a healthcare provider. The project was built on time and was successful. The service was running in the clients own Kubernetes cluster along with integrated microservices.

projects.name: Customer portal development
projects.description: Worked for the client continuing their customer portal development in close collaboration with the customer. Backend was developed using Kotlin, the UI was built with React. REST API was built with Ktor delivering the data to the frontend and the data was saved to a PostgreSQL database.

projects.name: Billing service architecture plan
projects.description: Worked as a software architect for developing an updated version of customer's billing service. Planned, devised, and built a thorough plan for the customer on how to start developing the new version of the billing service system. End result was high level cloud architecture for AWS, team composition, suggested ways of working and rough estimate of expense structure.

projects.name: SaaS SSO product
projects.description: Managed in-house team building authentication system for Finnish media companies, that could later be productized. Worked as an interface between customer and the team, handling client communication and organizing development work.
projects.x-note: No start/end dates given in the source, only the duration.

projects.name: Crane manual handling systems backend
projects.description: Designed and built a greenfield backend service for crane manual handling systems, integrating it into the client's large-scale, company-wide microservice architecture. Took full ownership of the backend from architecture to delivery, leveraging a broad AWS stack including Lambda, API Gateway, and ElasticSearch. After delivering the project on schedule, continued contributing across other team initiatives.

projects.name: Funding and partner search web application
projects.description: Responsible for creating web application for funding and partner search algorithm.
projects.x-note: No start/end dates given in the source, only the duration.

projects.name: Public telecom website
projects.description: Frontend development for telecompany website running on Magnolia CMS. Organisation was using SAFE, worked as part of a team responsible of building public site.

projects.name: Liferay frontend components
projects.description: Developed frontend components for Liferay application and few smaller projects.

projects.name: Insurance and pension application
projects.description: Started as a trainee and worked as part of a Scrum team that was responsible for building a large insurance and pension application customised for the company's client.
